syllabus_extract: Conception of transmission and reception. Modulation definition, need for modulation, types of modulation
specific_objectives: 21.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand the basic theory of communication.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list

practical: Review of modulation waveforms using PDF diagrams; Instructor supervision required for diagram interpretation.
intro_questions: What is the basic function of a communication system?
Define the term 'modulation' in your own words.
Why is direct transmission of high-frequency signals difficult?

development.content:
Basic theory of communication
Transmission and reception conception
Signal generation and propagation

Definition of modulation
Need for modulation
Advantages of modulation

Types of modulation
Amplitude modulation basics
Frequency modulation basics

summary_questions: Explain why modulation is necessary for efficient transmission.
Differentiate between amplitude and frequency modulation.
Describe the basic process of signal reception.
